dnaEdges.evidence: We mourn seven heroes: Michael Smith, Dick Scobee, Judith Resnik...
Nancy and I are pained to the core... This is truly a national loss
The future doesn't belong to the fainthearted; it belongs to the brave.
to the schoolchildren of America who were watching the live coverage
We do it all up front and in public. That's the way freedom is... Nothing ends here
slipped the surly bonds of earth to touch the face of God

counterfactualScenarios.name: Scenario A: Original Documentary Order (Actual Video)
counterfactualScenarios.description: Starts with anti-militarist poster & SPK_01 (0-45s), followed by 4 consecutive legal/pragmatic speakers (45-195s).

counterfactualScenarios.name: Scenario B: Reversed Framing Order (Anti-Militarist Last)
counterfactualScenarios.description: Places institutional/legal speakers first and ends with SPK_01's anti-militarist abolitionist critique and activist poster.

counterfactualScenarios.name: Scenario C: Balanced Airtime Counterfactual
counterfactualScenarios.description: Equalizes exposure duration between the abolitionist stance (SPK_01) and the pragmatic/legal coalition (SPK_02..05).
